# ascii-sharks (vendored)

Fish and sharks drawn as ASCII on a canvas, by drewdi.

- Source: https://github.com/stackedlol/ascii-sharks
- Commit: a0074c1
- License: MIT (see `LICENSE`)

The files here are an unmodified copy of the upstream `src/` directory. The
package is not published to npm, so it is vendored. To update, replace these
files with the upstream `src/` contents.
